title: QA run · release-18.3.0-w5-p0 (23/23) · 589049b0 · 2026-11-03 · 20 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWT669ynWFKZjqFyNF
Part of #27377 (18.3.0 pre-cut re-check, wave 5, card W5-P0: the standing `priority:P0` smoke at the wave-5 subject)

This run re-judges every P0 item at the wave-5 subject `589049b0`, 463 commits after the wave-4 subject `7fa9873f`, and compares each item with the wave-4 P0 record #28927.

**Result:** all 23 runnable items have a verdict: **20 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 NOT-RUN**.

**Against #28927** (21 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL), one verdict moved:
- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` went **PASS → FAIL** on acceptance[4]. On a packaged app's record page the Changes chip no longer shows the record's field-change history: the page request sends `timeline.fieldChanges:false` and never reads `sys_audit_log`. Cause: a9322700 (#29846, merged 2026-11-03 07:40Z), which narrowed a packaged app's record route to its package scope, so `sys_audit_log` is no longer in the list `RecordDetailView`'s `historyEnabled` reads. A second, independent agent re-derived the FAIL from a fresh boot (RUNNER rule 7) and agrees; the pin the clause cites, `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts`, fails the same way at this subject. Product defect, extracted (close-out comment).
- The two PARTIALs are the same standing `blocked(dependency)` clauses as at #28927: `access-security.rls-both-sides` acceptance[5] (knownGaps[0], #22017 row 11) and `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[5] (#23267).
- `approvals.account-app-entry` was judged live in full again: PASS holds (non-admin approver, every decision server-side, non-participant refused on every door).

**Today's breaking tightenings** (clause that reached each):
- #29845 (plugin-security, a write refused to a caller who cannot read the object answers the same for a hidden and a missing row): reached beside `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[1]. Its own cells sit in the unchanged arm and pass; the changed arm was driven off-clause on `sys_user_permission_set` / `sys_user_position` / `showcase_contact` / `showcase_client_brief` as member, contributor and delegate: existing and missing ids answer the identical 403, with and without `If-Match`. Pins `update-by-id-refusal-order` 19/19 [HTTP] and `by-id-write-unreadable-not-found` 23/23 [plugin unit].
- #29812 (rest/runtime, a datasource's remote structure needs the read capability on every route): reached beside `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` acceptance[1] and [7]. A `manage_metadata`-only persona is refused 403 naming `manage_platform_settings` on all 10 remote-structure routes, writes included (`external/tables`, `…/draft`, `…/import`, `refresh-catalog`, `validate`, `remote-tables`, `test`, `object-draft`, `datasources/test`, `meta/external_catalog`); a `manage_platform_settings`-only persona reads them and is refused the two writes naming `manage_metadata`.
- #29787 / #29836 (plugin-sharing, a failed manager / business-unit head read refuses): not reached. No P0 clause performs a failed head or manager read; the only sharing expansions seen (`verify --rls`, the boot's `share_new_inquiries_with_field_ops`) completed or expanded empty without a failed read.

**Other findings:** the off-clause probes produced four product cards and re-checked the five wave-4 probe cards, all of which no longer reproduce (below). No security finding.

## Environment fingerprint
- **Framework:** `589049b023d82c94508bf9fce752ea19069279e5` (main, merge of #29790), a detached checkout including `ui/`. `git status` was clean before and after the run.
- **CI on the subject:** push run 41600797636 re-read after testing: `completed`, conclusion `success` (every battery job and every shard).
- **Build** (cold tree, in this checkout):
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, exit 0 (27 s);
  - `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 119/119 tasks, exit 0, 15m04s (08:25:26Z–08:40:59Z);
  - `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2`, exit 0: `✓ @objectstack/console dist ready (83252 KB) from ui/apps/console, with the tracked sdui.manifest.json`;
  - `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green (106 artifacts).
- **Stale console bundle, ruled out:** every boot served `/_console/` entry `assets/index-DxniAR88.js`, the same file as `packages/console/dist/assets`; R5 and R6 compared the bytes with `cmp`, identical. The FAIL was also reproduced against the console from source through vite.
- **Toolchain:** Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0. Playwright 1.63.0 resolves chromium build 1243, which `/opt/pw-browsers` holds.
- **App:** `examples/app-showcase`. One dispatcher compile boot (port 44001) wrote `dist/objectstack.json` at 08:41Z; every later boot used `--no-compile --no-watch` (its mtime was unchanged at the end). Items that install, compile, write the external datasource, run `verify --rls`, `os start` or the ceremony, or touch a v17 / 18.0 pre-release DB booted from scratch copies (tar, `node_modules` symlinked). After the run `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/` holds only `data/` (no `installed-packages/`).
- **Boot line:** `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads OS_HOME=RUN/home setsid pnpm -C … exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:RUN/ITEM.db`, with `--log-level info` where an item asks. Seed: `Seeds: com.example.showcase 132 rows`. `/api/v1/health` reports version 18.2.0, the unreleased line.
- **Ports:** 44001 (dispatcher), 44101–44103 (R1), 44201–44203 (R2), 44301–44304 (R3), 44401–44419 (R4), 44501–44502 (R5), 44601–44602 (R6), 44701–44709 + 44719 PostgreSQL (R7), 44801–44803 (verifier). Each item ran on its own file DB. Every server was stopped by process group; every port was empty at the end.
- **Walled leg:** `os dev` with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`: banner `Tenancy: isolated`, `Organizations` mounted, no DEGRADED; `/auth/config` multiOrgEnabled true, degradedTenancy false.
- **v17-shaped DB:** npm `create-objectstack@17.7.0` (`--skip-install --skip-skills`, `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`, cli/runtime 17.7.0), booted once by its own `os dev`: 69 tables, 61 rows. **18.0 pre-release DB:** the `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore (born under `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5`). Only copies were used, with a checksum or row diff around every step.
- **Scratch PostgreSQL 16:** 127.0.0.1:44719, scram-sha-256, data dir under `/tmp` per the item's knownGaps[2].
- **Timestamps (2026-11-03):** prep 08:25Z–08:42Z; runners 08:42Z–09:17Z; rule-7 verifier 09:09Z–09:17Z.

## Execution
Parallel, per SKILL §2: seven runner subagents (R1–R7) plus one rule-7 verifier, each at effort `high` on the default tier (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate), each with its own port range and file DBs. API and CLI items fanned out (R1–R4); browser and mixed items on R5, R6, R7, one browser each. Vitest pins ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` at `--maxWorkers=1`. The dispatcher checked each runner's verdicts against the evidence it returned.
